lines.speaker: Breeze
lines.text: Zinc and brass, my dear — the metals nobody respects until they've felt them. Riot a man with zinc and his own temper does your work for you. Soothe him with brass and he simply... loses interest.

lines.speaker: Breeze
lines.text: The same trick, writ larger. Aim brass at that lot before they do something the guards will remember, or aim zinc if you'd rather they finally did something about it. Either way, you're not asking — you're choosing for them.
